My name is Garrett Wilkes; I am a licensed speech therapist living in Washington state. This blog is a combination of two passions: 1) video games and 2) needlessly nitpicking/brooding over words.

feeds.title: RPG Site
feeds.description: Founded in 2006 by long-time alumni of more niche communities, the RPG Site was created with one clear-cut mission in mind: To be a one-stop destination for coverage of all games in the broader world of role-playing video games. We aim to be the only resource any RPG gamer will need for information and opinion on their favourite genre.

feeds.title: Hardcore Gaming 101
feeds.description: Hardcore Gaming 101 went live in the year 2004 and ever since has been one place that promotes the rich history of video games culture throughout the ages.

feeds.title: JRPG.moe
feeds.description: Welcome to JRPG.moe and the world of Japanese Role-Playing Games. This is an independent website for everyone who gets fired up about JRPGs and wants to get more out of the genre. Find out about new JRPGs, old JRPGs and basically the best JRPGs the genre has to offer. From Final Fantasy to Fire Emblem, Pokémon to Persona, Tales of the Abyss to Tales of Zestiria, we're aiming to cover it all.
